Package org.webharvest.definition

Class DefinitionResolver

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.webharvest.definition.AbstractRefreshableResolver
      • org.webharvest.definition.DefinitionResolver
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ConfigurableResolver
    public class DefinitionResolver
extends AbstractRefreshableResolver
    Class contains information and logic to validate and crate definition classes for parsed xml nodes from Web-Harvest configurations.
    Author:
    Vladimir Nikic, Robert Bala
